lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are organized into approximately five primary horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region, forming a semi-regular grid-like distribution.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating high-contrast anchor nodes primarily in the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature is present along the upper-lateral flank, characterized by a high-intensity luminance on the dorsal side transitioning to a shadow-cast gradient on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse distribution of approximately 5-8 high-luminance spots is visible within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin, primarily localized toward the leading edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A sharp transition in pattern scale is visible, moving from high-density, small-diameter speckling on the anterior snout to lower-density, larger-diameter blobs on the mid-lateral flank.
